My name is Rimjhim Saxena . I am a **Postdoctoral Researcher at the University of Geneva, Switzerland (GSEM)**. I graduated with my PhD in Economics from the [University of Colorado, Boulder](https://www.colorado.edu/economics/) in 2025. I like working at the intersection of Environment + Development, preferably with a good coffee.
